russian-swears-male-voice-pack.title: Russian swears male voice pack
russian-swears-male-voice-pack.author: Reactorcore
russian-swears-male-voice-pack.body: # Russian swears male voice pack This is an asset pack of .mp3 audio files of russian swear words spoken in a mostly calm male voice with a "well... sh*t." type of delivery. ## Contents Includes these lines, 22 .mp3 files in total, some have multiple variants/retakes: Блять! На хуй! Охуеть! Пизда! Сука! Бля! Хуйня! Пиздец! Ебать! Заебись! Жопа! Ебаный! Пиздёж! F*ck! (They're common single word swears that mostly express "f*ck, sh*t, d*mn" about an unfavorable situation. Only a handful could also serve double-use as insults, like the classic Cyka and Blyat, but the rest not so much.) These are useful for game over screen sound bites, comedic character death sounds, ragdoll "pain" sounds, or for "access denied" moments in adventure games. ## Other Stuff Check out my other cool stuff: https://reactorcore.itch.io/ https://linktr.ee/reactorcore ## Contact mailto:reactorcoregames@gmail.com

the-free-firearm-sound-library.title: The Free Firearm Sound Library
the-free-firearm-sound-library.author: Ben Jaszczak, et al. (Submitted by bart )
the-free-firearm-sound-library.body: From The Free Firearm Sound Library homepage : The firearm sound library was the brainchild of a team of college students with a mutual passion for the audio and visual arts. In November, 2013 we launched a Kickstarter campaign to develop an extensive open source firearm sound effects library, and on December 7, 2013 our project was funded by an incredible group of backers and we went into full tilt production. This website serves to connect our backers with our two libraries, as well as to give credit to the backers who made it all possible. Along with the availability of these sounds comes the need to understand their proper application. The metadata included in the sound files along with some instructional videos will help make these sounds serve you to their full potential. Our team holds CC0 NO RIGHTS RESERVED for this library. It may be used without royalty or credit (though we would love to hear how you've used our sounds) for any application, personal or professional. Have at it! Please note that OGA is not affiliated with this project, and as such, we encourage you to visit their site so as to make sure you're getting the latest version of the files: http://freefirearmsfx.com raw prepared Also note that their website includes instructions along with the raw versions of the sound effects, which are not archived here. Big thanks to their team and all of their Kickstarter supporters for this amazing collection!

the-chaos-has-risen.title: The Chaos Has Risen
the-chaos-has-risen.author: jdagenet
the-chaos-has-risen.body: A short, eerie, drama stinger that could be used in suspensful situations to let the viewer know, "It's been taken up a notch...". The ZIP folder contains two audio files. One file is the original, non-edited version with a sustained tail of audio going all the way down to 0.0 db. The other file is a reversed, looped version that is tempo-synced to four beats and four measures at 70.0 BPM. Enjoy!
